source: 人教版普通高中英语教科书 (2019) · PEP

modules.description_cn: 基本句型、名词/形容词/副词短语（教材 Discovering Useful Structures）
现在进行时表将来、一般现在/过去等（各册 Grammar）
定语从句、状语从句等（选必阶段）

points_note: Grammar points are defined in pep-bundle.json (generated from 7 PEP PDFs). Modules/categories below are UI taxonomy only.

points.title: 基本句型（SV / SVO / SP）
points.explanation: 教材 Welcome Unit：主语 + 谓语 (+ 宾语/表语)。如 *We laughed.* / *I miss my grandma.* / *The teacher was kind.*
points.typical_example: I had my first maths class at senior high school.
points.common_mistake: 漏写 be 动词或宾语：*The teacher kind.*

points.title: 名词短语与形容词短语
points.explanation: Unit 1 Discovering Useful Structures：名词短语 (NP)、形容词短语 (AdjP)、副词短语 (AdvP) 作修饰或补语。
points.typical_example: The building is so big that I'm completely lost.
points.common_mistake: 形容词与副词混用：*speak quick* → speak quickly

points.title: 现在进行时表将来计划
points.explanation: 教材 Travel 单元：用 *be going to* / 现在进行时表示计划与安排。
points.typical_example: We are going to learn about wildlife.
points.common_mistake: 与一般将来时混用时间状语：*I will go tomorrow* vs *I'm going tomorrow*

points.title: 限制性定语从句 (that/which)
points.explanation: 必修第二册：限制性定语从句修饰名词，that/which/who 不可省略关系代词（作宾语可省略）。
points.typical_example: The lab is new and the lesson was great.
points.common_mistake: 关系代词与先行词数不一致

points.title: 被动语态
points.explanation: 必修第三册：be + 过去分词，注意时态一致。
points.typical_example: Food is handed out to homeless people in the community.
points.common_mistake: 遗漏 be 动词：*The food handed out.*

points.title: 非谓语动词（不定式/动名词）
points.explanation: 选择性必修第一册：to do / doing 作主语、宾语、定语。
points.typical_example: I hope to be fluent when I graduate.
points.common_mistake: forget to do vs forget doing 语义混淆

points.title: 虚拟语气
points.explanation: 选必二：if 虚拟、wish 从句等高考高频结构。
points.typical_example: I wish I didn't have to do this!
points.common_mistake: 虚拟语气仍用一般过去时主句：*If I was you* → If I were you

points.title: 倒装句
points.explanation: 选必三：否定词前置、only + 状语等引起的部分倒装。
points.typical_example: Never have I seen such a beautiful view.

points.title: 语篇衔接与逻辑
points.explanation: 选必四：连接词、指代、段落逻辑（读写综合）。
points.typical_example: Still, I'm happy to be here.
points.common_mistake: 连接词误用导致逻辑跳跃
